correctness.rationale: The bijection from canonical twice-occurring words to matchings is exact; admissible splits select one endpoint from every matched pair. Independently, all gamma-splits arise by interleaving two prescribed permutations, with duplicate pairings removed. The scripts exhaust all k! permutations and every pairing (2k-1)!! or each interleaving binomial(2k,k) for k<=6. Both algorithms agree on all 720 size-six degrees, all 120 size-five degrees, the unique maximal permutations and 508/123 cyclic controls. Two packaged full tables are checked. These are complete finite proofs, not samples or infinite extrapolations.

value.rationale: The defining 2023 paper explicitly asks for the maximum permutation-vertex degree of this incidence graph. The exact k=5,6 values and unique inverse extremizers are natural initial finite cases of that open structural problem, and k=5 marks the first observed transition from cyclic to non-cyclic maximizers. This is a sharp, mathematically motivated comparison across all canonical double-occurrence words, not an arbitrary unmotivated slice or a known table recomputation.
